stops.note: named the gum chewed from the sapodilla tree's sap
the Maya and Aztecs chewed it; Thomas Adams made the first chicle chewing gum in New York in 1871
stops.meaning: the natural gum of the sapodilla tree

stops.note: entered English when the gum was exported to the U.S. and became the base of early chewing gum
stops.meaning: a natural latex used as the base for chewing gum

current_meaning: a natural gum from the sapodilla tree, historically the base ingredient of chewing gum
